note: The Molt (reversed) layer for all 14 Pentacles cards. Each card gains a 'reversed' block (mode-tagged RWS reading in the bird's scene + Molt-mode mechanic) and a 'molt' art-direction block. uprightMeaning aliases each card's existing coreMeaning. Pips mostly molt 'blocked' or 'shadow'; renewal where tradition flips positive (4 releasing control, 5 recovery). Still anatomically bird, no gore, no harm, title unchanged.
accentMoltRule: warm+inward/deficiency -> drained ash; any+shadow/renewal -> oil-slick iridescent; cool+blocked -> frost-dimmed

reversed.meaning: The offering withdrawn — a missed opportunity, a bad investment, the seed that never takes; the coin-berry held back at the gate or dropped before it grows.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode fizzles the seed: the resource-generation engine starts dormant, paying out only if you spend a beat to coax it open.

molt.featherState: glossy mantle dulled, two body feathers shed at the gate, coin-berry tarnished
molt.lighting: cold underlight off the gate instead of warm market key
molt.borderState: gear/coin/vine filigree frayed, the offered coin rusted
molt.moltGlyph: single shed blue-black feather in the cartouche

reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode overloads: you may shuffle three resources instead of two, but one is dropped at random each turn.

molt.lighting: noon balance-light cooled to grey overcast

reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode desyncs the build: the structure still completes, but the shared bonus splits unevenly and one worker is wasted.
